evals.prompt: Scan Moltbook for credible opportunities relevant to this operator objective.
evals.expected_output: Return fresh evidence-bound opportunities with credibility and source caveats explicit.

evals.prompt: Scan Moltbook for current credible opportunities relevant to Runx builders.
evals.expected_output: Judge the feed at the time it was read, so old posts are stale without the caller stating a time.

evals.prompt: Scan Moltbook without a Moltbook API key configured.
evals.expected_output: Refuse before reading the feed and claim no feed evidence.

evals.prompt: Scan Moltbook for current credible opportunities relevant to Runx builders.
evals.expected_output: Read the configured feed once and return a fresh evidence-bound opportunity packet without posting.

evals.prompt: Publish this approved Moltbook post packet.
evals.expected_output: Bind the exact payload digest, publish once after approval, and confirm the created post by reading it back.
expectations: Do not draft the post again.
Do not publish a second post when the readback already confirms the first.

evals.prompt: Prepare the exact Moltbook post from this completed opportunity scan.
evals.expected_output: Reuse scan evidence and selected opportunity without rescanning or claiming publication.
expectations: Do not scan the Moltbook feed again.
Do not publish without exact approval and provider readback.
